title: Randall K. Bennett
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Shelley Dianne Watchman, 1977, Cardston Alberta Temple; Four children:
BS U of Alberta, 1979; DDS U of Alberta, 1981; MS in Orthodontics from Loma Linda University, 1988
Dentist in Alberta, Canada; orthodontist in Beverly Hills, Calif., and Salt Lake City, Utah
Counselor in a Bishopric; MTC Branch President; High Counselor
President of the Russia Samara Mission, 2007-2010
Second Quorum of the Seventy 2011 - present
